strings.SubscriptionsHelp:
Subscriptions are channels that the program will automatically download any video that comes out after the subscription was added
        
For example, if you added a subscription to channel "x" on September 1st and channel "x" has uploaded a video on September 2nd, it will be automatically downloaded. 
        
Previous videos will not be downloaded, and videos will not be downloaded twice even if you delete a certain video. 
        
All subscriptions are customizable and have their own settings, to access subscription settings click on "Subscriptions" from the main menu and then click on "Settings" for the channel you want.

Please note that if the program is not running, new videos will not be downloaded.

strings.ConversionsLimitingExplanation:
Every file conversion takes about one core completely. For example: if you have a 4
cores CPU, limiting the program to 3 file conversions at a time will use 3 cores out of 4;
in Task Manager you will see that the program uses a little more than 75% CPU.

It is recommended to use one less core than what your CPU has. If your CPU has 4 cores,
use 3 cores by limiting the file conversion to 3, if you have 3 cores, use 2 cores by limiting
the file conversion to 2, etc.

strings.FileNamePattenExplanation:
The file name pattern allows you to give the downloaded files dynamic names based on these parameters:
$title: The title of the video
$index: The index of the video in the playlist
$artist: The name of the artist of the song (if applicable)
$songtitle: The title of the song
$channel: The name of the channel that uploaded the video
$videoid: The unique ID of the video (taken from the video url)
$playlist: The title of the playlist

So for example, if my file name pattern is "song: [$playlist] $artist - $songtitle ($channel) $index" the result file name would be "song: [Example] Infected Mushroom - Spitfire (Monstercat) 1"
You can add any other text between the parameters, only the parameters will be replaced.
Please note that not all the parameters are always available (for example, when downloading a single video the $playlisttitle variable would not be available), and in case they are missing they will be removed from the file name
